zh: 下班后我顺路去接孩子。
old_en: After work, I picked up my child on the way home.
new_en: After work, I pick up my child on my way home.

zh: 朋友让我在门口等他，他会开车来接我。
old_en: He picked me up at the door, as he would come to fetch me by car.
new_en: My friend asked me to wait at the door, he will pick me up in his car.
